text:
Marie Chen: Quick status — noticed a 3–5% p50 latency bump on canary v3 after the continuous-batching kernel change. p50 went 12ms -> 13ms; kv hit rate down ~6%. @Ajay @Derek can you take a look? infra-bot shows the canary deploy at 15:42 PT. <https://dash.redwood/internal/canary/1755|canary dashboard>

Ajay Patel: Saw the alert. Looking at traces now — spans show extra time in the KV path. My first guess is the small mutex/serialization regressed after the prefetch reorder (commit ab12ef).

Derek Lu: Reproduced locally: reverting ab12ef brings kv hit rate back and latency to baseline. I'll open a revert PR now.

Marie Chen: Ownership: Derek = immediate revert + canary rollback; Ajay = root-cause perf analysis + perf tests; Sarah = coordinate rollback window with SRE.

Sarah O'Neill: Ack. Scheduling a 15min rollback window at 16:00 PT if the revert doesn't land. I'll page oncall and update the runbook.

infra-bot: canary-deploy: v3 rolled at 15:42 — traffic: 0.1 -> 0.3 -> 0.5

Derek Lu: PR: git.redwood/infer/runtime#1423 — "revert(ab12ef): undo prefetch reorder to restore KV path concurrency". Requesting quick review from @Marie and @Ajay. I'll add bench numbers in the PR body.

Ajay Patel: Reviewing now. Adding a focused microbenchmark in CI that simulates high concurrency with continuous batching + warm KV cache. Also adding a unit perf test for the prefetch pipeline.

Marie Chen: Small ask: add metric kv/lock_hold_ms (ms) and alert if p99 > 5ms. Also add a synthetic that exercises continuous batching + long prompts (seq_len 2048).

Sarah O'Neill: Scheduled rollback at 16:05 PT if PR not merged. Oncall: @Dylan please monitor p50/p95 and kv hit rate during rollback. Dashboard: <https://dash.redwood/d/kv/canary|KV canary dashboard>.

Dylan (oncall): On it. Muting noisy alerts and will post status updates every 5m.

Marie Chen: Follow-ups: Ajay to own root-cause ticket RINF-3245, Derek to maintain hotfix branch, infra to add a post-deploy checklist item to run the new KV microbenchmark before increasing traffic.

Derek Lu: I'll include bench numbers (before/after) in the PR description and tag @eng-sre for a quick postmortem if client-facing latency > 2%.

Ajay Patel: Root cause narrowed to a serialization point in PrefetchPipeline: recreated in microbench. Diff will remove one extra lock acquisition around cache warmup. Snippet: ```cpp
// culprit: unnecessary lock during prefetch warmup
std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(cache_mutex);
prefetch_warmup(...);
```
I'll post the perf diffs in the PR.

Marie Chen: Nice work. Triage complete for now — keep posting progress here. :thumbsup:
